SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, p.user_id AS userId, p.title, SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 200) AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.is_top AS isTop, p.is_essence AS isEssence, p.status, p.last_reply_time AS lastReplyTime, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, b.name AS boardName FROM post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND p.board_id = #{boardId}
AND p.is_essence = 1
ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.last_reply_time DESC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.is_top = 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.is_top DESC, p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, p.user_id AS userId, p.title, SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 200) AS content, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.reply_count AS replyCount, p.is_top AS isTop, p.is_essence AS isEssence, p.status, p.last_reply_time AS lastReplyTime, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, b.name AS boardName FROM post p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN board b ON p.board_id = b.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
